user.title: Battery and power
user.description: Pick the battery and power sensors. With EF-PowerOcean-TcpModbus installed they are filled in.

data_description.battery_power: Power into or out of the battery.
data_description.battery_capacity: Nominal capacity in Wh or kWh. While it reports none, the last value is used.
data_description.battery_reserve: The reserve in force, in %. For EF-PowerOcean-TcpModbus use Effective Battery Reserve.
data_description.house_power: What the house uses right now.
data_description.grid_power: Grid exchange; the sign is set in the options.

energy.title: Energy counters
energy.description: Pick the energy counters. Long-term statistics are read from them, so daily and lifetime counters both work.

data_description.solar_energy: A counter of solar energy produced; daily or lifetime.
data_description.house_energy: A counter of energy the house used.
data_description.battery_charge_energy: A counter of energy into the battery.
data_description.battery_discharge_energy: A counter of energy out of the battery.

data_description.solcast_today: The Solcast sensor for today, with its detailedForecast attribute.
data_description.solcast_later: Day 3 onwards, to compare tomorrow with the week.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Prices, battery limits and what counts as cooking.

data.charge_positive: Battery power is positive when charging
data.import_positive: Grid power is positive when importing

data_description.price: What you pay per kWh bought, in ct.
data_description.feed_in: What you get per kWh exported, in ct.
data_description.price_entity: Overrides the price; in ct/kWh, or €/kWh if its unit says so.
data_description.feed_in_entity: Overrides the feed-in tariff, the same way.
data_description.min_reserve: The lowest the inverter discharges to by itself, under any reserve.
data_description.max_power: The most the battery charges or discharges at.
data_description.charge_positive: Turn off if charging shows as negative.
data_description.import_positive: Turn off if import shows as negative.
data_description.cook_threshold: House power beyond the metered appliances, during the evening, that counts as cooking.
data_description.upgrade_kwh: The added capacity valued by the upgrade sensor.
data_description.upgrade_cost: Its price, for the payback time.

data_description.default_kwh: Used until the first runs have been measured.
data_description.default_hours: Used until the first runs have been measured.
